<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD for capella-bin follows standard Arch Linux packaging practices. It downloads the application tarball from mirror.umd.edu (a legitimate Eclipse project mirror) and an icon from the official eclipse-capella GitHub repository. Both sources have SHA512 checksums provided for integrity verification. The prepare() function only runs gendesk to generate a .desktop file, and the package() function performs routine installation steps (extracting to /opt, creating a symlink, installing desktop entry and icon). No obfuscated code, data exfiltration, execution of downloaded scripts, or unauthorized system modifications are present. The package does not run any build system, as it distributes a pre-built binary tarball.
</details>
